# git-a2a schema 2

The only domain commands are `init`, `add`, `pull`, `remove`, `list`, and `whose`. One dependency alias
records its Git source, requested ref, exact applied commit, and saved adapter variants. Every
polyglot binding and the optional surface use that commit. `list` reports all aliases; `whose
NAME` reports one owner, usable Agent Card reference, and available surface. Both are offline and
read-only.

An upstream used as a dependency must declare one `agent.card`. The Agent Card remains the source
of interfaces, skills, and authentication. git-a2a never sends a message, runs or hosts an agent,
or manages tasks. An external A2A client performs communication.

`add` installs or resolves code using applicable adapters. `pull` updates every dependency;
`pull NAME` updates one. Both use native manager operations, including restoration of missing
installed state. Pull resolves the declared ref again rather than replaying the old lock.
`remove` reconciles native declarations, locks, and installed state while preserving other
dependencies. Git submodule is an ordinary adapter and an explicit initial-selection fallback
for unsupported native sources; missing tools do not trigger a manager switch.

An HTTPS Agent Card remains a URL. A repository-relative card is copied byte-for-byte from the
applied commit to `.git-a2a/agents/NAME/` and exposed by `whose` as a usable local reference.
Read the optional published surface, consult the responsible agent using an external A2A client,
then consume its published changes with `pull NAME`.

## End-to-end demo

The ACME demo connects a component, discovers its responsible agent, sends a request through A2A,
lets the owner change the library, runs `git-a2a pull`, and verifies the new result. Clone the app
and library repositories next to each other. Docker with Compose is required:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/neprel/git-a2a-demo-acme-lib.git
git clone https://github.com/neprel/git-a2a-demo-acme-app.git
cd git-a2a-demo-acme-app
./demo/run.sh
DEMO_PROFILE=npm ./demo/run.sh
```

The agents are deterministic and need no LLM API keys. The demo uses real A2A transport,
published git-a2a 2.0.0, and temporary local Git remotes. A separate demo client performs A2A
communication; git-a2a manages dependency code and metadata. The agents are local to each run,
not permanently available public services.

Demo sources and evidence:
- App and walkthrough: https://github.com/neprel/git-a2a-demo-acme-app#readme
- Library: https://github.com/neprel/git-a2a-demo-acme-lib
